shots.detail_en: Late night server room atop Lianhua Tower; blue glow on Xiong Wei's rimless glasses, a screen field reads 'STRESS TEST TARGET: Xiong Tiancheng'.
shots.sub: 全盘扫描完，唯一的非理性敞口——是我父亲。
shots.speaker: 熊伟

shots.detail_en: Screen scrolls ten years of rigging traces as abstract tape silhouettes (compliance-blurred); red dots link into one line.
shots.sub: 模型管这条线叫'风险源'。我管它叫——爸的轨迹。
shots.speaker: 熊伟

shots.detail_en: Xiong Wei pulls a hand-bound booklet from the archive cabinet: 'The Xiong Family Creed', copied by his own hand.
Pen-nib close-up writes a new line on the title page: 'Dad, the market punishes the greedy.'
shots.speaker: 熊伟

shots.detail_en: Keyboard close-up: rule field typed into the model — 'Liquidation condition: greed > threshold' — Enter pressed.
shots.sub: 从今天起，你自己的信条，开始给你计分。
shots.speaker: 熊伟

shots.detail_en: Day trading hall, flip board mixed with new LED wall rolling red; Chang Hong in a suit commands mid-floor, no longer a sweeper.
shots.sub: 新经济大潮里的港海，人人都在追风口。可 K 线爬得最陡的地方，离悬崖最近。
shots.speaker: 旁白

shots.detail_en: Man Cang in flower shirt squeezes through the crowd, slapping his own chest.
shots.sub: 虹哥，弹药全到位！我全仓，我爹的养老钱也全仓——稳得很！
shots.speaker: 王满仓

shots.detail_en: Chang Hong's eyes narrow, a half-beat pause.
shots.sub: 满仓叔的钱……我拿去喂机器了。喂一台，不会心软的机器。
shots.speaker: 陆长虹

shots.detail_en: Four-shot rapid cuts: algo flash-orders slam the board / red-green crossfire / paper slips fly / Chang Hong cold-eyed placing orders.
shots.sub: 它没有心，所以读不懂死账户。我就用这份'读不懂'，给它设陷阱。
shots.speaker: 旁白

shots.detail_en: Board: a huge green column on 'Lianhua Network' slams down then hooks back up; Man Cang leaps up grabbing his head.
shots.speaker: 王满仓

shots.detail_en: Server-room screen popup: 'Trap identified: confirmed. Sample archived.'
shots.sub: 谢谢你的死账户。它比十次访谈都好用——我看清了你的全部底仓。
shots.speaker: 熊伟

shots.detail_en: Chang Hong's face freezes for the first time, eyes locked on the board.
shots.sub: 不对……它在学我。不——它在吃我。
shots.speaker: 陆长虹

shots.detail_en: After close, Hong Li blocks Chang Hong, a stack of ledger pages slapped on the rail.
shots.sub: 账目不会撒谎。第五笔调仓的那个户头——是满仓他爹的养老钱。
shots.speaker: 沈红利

shots.detail_en: Chang Hong offers no excuse; Hong Li stares at him.
shots.sub: 陆长虹：'战役需要筹码。' 沈红利：'你父亲当年，也是这么说的。'
shots.speaker: 陆长虹、沈红利

shots.detail_en: The light in Hong Li's eyes dims one notch.
shots.sub: 账，我可以做平。可账目平了，人心平不了。
shots.speaker: 沈红利

shots.detail_en: Transition: Xiong family dining room under a warm lamp, father and son eating face to face.
Xiong Tiancheng serves his son food, smiling with mercy.
shots.sub: 阿伟，外头都说我这套盘子老派了。你比我冷静——联华，迟早是你的。
shots.speaker: 熊天成

shots.detail_en: Xiong Wei folds the creed page and slides it into his breast pocket, over his heart.
shots.sub: 爸，模型说——你的分，快扣完了。
shots.speaker: 熊伟

shots.detail_en: Xiong Tiancheng turns his prayer beads; neon light washes his kind profile.
shots.sub: 我从来没有做错过任何事。
shots.speaker: 熊天成

shots.detail_en: Xiong Wei rises to leave, looks back at his father for a long beat at the door.
shots.sub: 熊伟：'爸，晚安。' 熊天成：'好孩子。'
shots.speaker: 熊伟、熊天成

shots.detail_en: Black-field next-episode card.
shots.sub: 他把父亲的信条写进了程序。现在，只欠一次表决。
shots.card: 他把父亲的信条写进了程序。现在，只欠一次表决。
